property_summary: In the reference C, once a user has locked in a guess (guesses[msg.sender].block != 0), any further lockInGuess call reverts; the mutant removed this guard, so a second lockInGuess call by the same user succeeds, breaking the invariant.
change_summary: Remove the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) guard so users can overwrite an existing guess.
